title: About me
summary: Full-Stack Web Developer and System Analyst with a strong Computer Engineering foundation (GPAX 3.91) and experience delivering solutions for government agencies, universities, enterprises, and startups. I bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution. My expertise spans the entire SDLC: translating user requirements into system architectures, data models (ERD), and API specifications, and building those solutions especially using Next.js and Express.js. I specialize in developing management systems that drive digital transformation, and I am passionate about combining robust engineering with strategic design to build high-impact, user-centric products.
